newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean yields finish higher on feeble buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields finish higher on feeble buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds climbed on Tuesday as investor interest lagged despite fewer new issues, brokers said.
Three-month certificates of deposit (CD) yields and overnight call rates also gained on tightening short-term liquidity.
* Overnight average call rates at 13.5 vs 12.8
They said the demand for cash was rising prior to the year-end holidays.
Three-month certificates of deposit (CD) yields and overnight call rates rose on the back of tighter short-term liquidity.
The market will be closed for trading on Christmas day.
